name: Paneer Jalfrezi
steps: Cut paneer and vegetables into similar-length strips. Pat paneer dry, and keep peppers separate from tomato so they stay crisp.
Heat half the oil in a wide pan over medium-high heat. Sear paneer for 1 minute per side until lightly golden; lift it out before it toughens.
Add remaining oil and cumin to the pan. Stir-fry onion and peppers for 4–5 minutes so their edges char slightly while the centers remain firm.
Add ginger, garlic, chopped tomato, tomato paste, coriander powder, chili powder and salt. Cook 4–5 minutes until tomato becomes a thick coating, not watery gravy.
Return paneer, toss gently for 2 minutes to coat, and turn off heat. Add lemon juice and coriander; serve immediately with roti.
tips: Jalfrezi should be semi-dry with distinct crisp pepper and paneer strips, not a smooth curry.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
